chunks: Say: 'O God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the visible, You will judge between Your servants regarding that over which they used to differ.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God judging between people regarding their differences?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Az-Zumar, this verse serves as a rhetorical transition where God commands the Prophet to invite disbelievers to acknowledge His exclusive authority, highlighting that the Creator of the heavens and earth is the sole Judge of the hidden and apparent. Shia exegesis emphasizes that this adjudication includes resolving theological and jurisprudential differences among the Ummah, affirming divine justice in the final reckoning. It underscores the certainty of the Hereafter as the ultimate resolution to worldly disputes.
